definitions: A small tower on top of a larger tower or at the corner of a building or wall, especially of a castle.
A low, flat, rotating structure, typically on a tank, warship, or aircraft, in which guns are mounted.
A rotating holder in a machine tool, holding several tools that can be brought successively into working position.
examples: The tank's turret rotated to face the enemy.
The lathe's turret allowed for quick tool changes.
